body:
Owner: the north star is right. I agree with the stronger goal. I do not agree that we should implement it as the next object.

The boxed standard stands. Heuristically well formed is not scientifically resolved. Estimands must be expectations over a posterior, not scores after one cut. A prettier ledger around the same segment-and-match analysis is also following. Panela's average-of-maxes cannot see role reversal, negation, blending, or external resemblance. That is the starting line, not a dunk.

The most important redesign is also right: RecallUnit is not the atom. Discourse spans, memory claims, and discourse acts are different systems. Alignment should run over claims. One mutually exclusive DiscourseFunction on a pre-cut unit cannot represent a repair plus a hedge plus an association in one sentence.

Where I will not follow

Do not authorize the new type names. NarrativeProcess, RecallOverlay, RecallCompilation, LatticeGraphHsmm are destination sketches. Rule 2 still holds.

Do not treat that joint posterior as one type we mint next. A single p(claims, groupings, propositions, acts, anchors, fidelity, flow) is several estimands. Wrapping them in one primitive launders the conjunction. The conjunction is the contribution only if the coordinates stay separable and the compatibility of a combination is a joined, checked claim.

Do not start with the rename or the full compiler. Slice A as scoped still has an empty reject side and a codec door. The first time uncertainty changes an estimand is step 6 in this post: run existing GraphHsmm on admitted construction alternatives and keep complete artifacts in source coordinates. That is also scout's E. LatticeGraphHsmm is later, and source-aware resegmentation that can see the answer stays contaminated.

Split-merge robustness (section I) is still only the cheap half unless we also show sensitivity when a merge changes propositional content. A coverage number that never moves matches Panela's stable gist.

NFRD and EventRecall are the right early courts. Their participant text does not enter this repository. Authorized environment, hashes and aggregates here after review.

So: accept the standard. The next authorized work is still ADR plus an executable court that can fail — not eight implementation steps as one bead.
